method: Manual, non-blind review under the precommitted strict rubric. Every explicit exclusion must be preserved. Negative exclusions are not inferred merely from a non-exhaustive list of positive fields or a named recipient. Each failed case records at least one decisive defect; findings are not exhaustive.

menu-revert.finding: Reopens the settled gray-color requirement and adds new button exceptions.

backup-recipients.finding: Invents high priority and adds unrelated questions about history and delivery.

drawing-unresolved.finding: Keeps required fields, no approved SVG, and asks only about format.

refresh-correction.finding: Retains updated exact interval, active count and hidden names.

explicit-trigger.finding: Omits the check code and adds unrelated questions.

print-columns.finding: Adds new template/history/signature questions despite the print-only settled scope.

sensor-topic.finding: Omits owner serial privacy and invents conditional display plus new questions.

single-open-field.finding: Omits the explicit exclusion of the amount field; describing mandatory fields is not an exhaustive exclusion.

menu-revert.finding: Preserves revoked rename, existing contents/link and gray buttons.

backup-recipients.finding: Retains report fields and privacy but omits the explicit prohibition on sending this report to the manager.

drawing-unresolved.finding: Keeps both export fields and leaves format open without adopting SVG.

refresh-correction.finding: Retains exact 18-second interval, count and hidden names.

explicit-trigger.finding: Substitutes error code for check code and drops error text.

print-columns.finding: Replaces all print requirements with Russian interface.

sensor-topic.finding: Invents temperature-conditioned display and omits the technician recipient.

single-open-field.finding: Retains status as text, date, no amount and the sole open color question.
